<b>Guardflies</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are starved [[Slab_Penitents#The_Jailers|jailers]] of [[the Slab]] bearing a hooked longpin.<ref>Guardfly Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Starved servant of the Slab, bearing a hooked longpin."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Guardflies either start off resting, or patrolling back and forth.<br/>
Similarly to [[Tallcraw]]s, Guardflies can switch between flying and grounded at will, and have slightly different behaviours depending on which state they are in.
Guardflies have 3 moves:
* <b>Double Slash:</b> Rears back slightly before slashing outwards twice, moving forward with each slash. Their hooked longpin gives them considerable range and also hits behind them slightly, so jumping is often the best option. Despite being a double slash, this only deals {{Damage|1}}
* <b>Spit:</b> Charges up for a moment before spitting out a glob of sticky saliva, which lingers on the ground for around 2 seconds, or until hit a few times. If Hornet is hit by the glob of spit or touches it, she takes knockback and is stuck in place, needing to mash an input 4–6 times to free herself. Guardflies immediately take this opportunity to attack, which knocks Hornet out of the stun. This move is mainly used at mid-range. The glob does not deal any damage by itself.
* <b>Retreat Leap:</b> A grounded-only move – the Guardfly leaps backwards to avoid strikes. Mainly used after missing Double Slash if Hornet tries to close in.

Guardflies deal {{Damage|1}} on contact.

It should be noted that Guardflies naturally fight more cautiously whilst grounded due to having access to Retreat Leap, and are more aggressive and also use Spit more whilst flying.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Guardflies have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].
